shared_content.cohort: Same 168 source-qualified sources with at least two candidates; actual budget min(k,n)
shared_content.uncertainty: Paired 95% source-bootstrap percentile interval; 5,000 draws; seed 20261021; fixed saved predictions; pointwise exploratory
shared_content.visual_standard: Read the existing shared VISUAL_STANDARD and publication tokens at render time; no local style override

observed_source_composition_diagnostic.filter: primary_cohort=True; adjudicated sources retaining fewer than two eligible recorded candidates are excluded
observed_source_composition_diagnostic.role: Post hoc observed-label diagnostic; unavailable as a preselection eligibility filter; not an alternative primary denominator

representation_resolution_diagnostic.join_to_primary_inventory: paper_family_id; current primary_cohort=True; same 168 qualified source identities

diagnostic_fraction.meaning: Post hoc fraction of observed mixed-label sources whose candidates all share the current X; not a primary-cohort success rate

representation_resolution_diagnostic.role: Current input representation cannot distinguish these recorded candidate states; this is not physical equivalence or a universal learning limit

shared_content.candidate_retention_scope: All 913 candidates in the qualified comparison; adjudicated sources below two eligible candidates withheld; frozen inputs and predictions unchanged

scientific_formula_semantics.candidate_hit: I(UTS>=1000 MPa and reported unspecified EL>=10%); stored numerical test-temperature scope 25 C
scientific_formula_semantics.uniform_at_least_one: For source s with n_s candidates and h_s observed hits, k_s=min(k,n_s): 1-C(n_s-h_s,k_s)/C(n_s,k_s), with C(a,b)=0 when b>a
scientific_formula_semantics.primary_source_average: Mean over all 168 source-qualified sources at every requested budget; fixed saved predictions
scientific_formula_semantics.mixed_only_diagnostic: The mixed-source mean sum(h_s/n_s)/47 = 0.41912108138944104 is post hoc; it cannot replace the all-168 comparator or its source bootstrap
scientific_formula_semantics.q: min(UTS/(1000 MPa), reported unspecified EL/(10%)); dimensionless and not capped at one
scientific_formula_semantics.regret: max(q over all recorded candidates in source)-max(q over selected candidates)
scientific_formula_semantics.attainment_gain: method minus exact uniform; multiply by 100 for percentage points
scientific_formula_semantics.regret_gain: exact uniform expected regret minus method regret; positive favors ranking
scientific_formula_semantics.label_informed_block_oracle: Observed-label X-block diagnostic source mean is 0.26883417508417506; not deployable or a learnable Bayes ceiling
scientific_formula_semantics.uncertainty: Original 5,000 whole-source resampling protocol applied only to affected qualified-source summaries; saved predictors and ranks fixed; no retraining uncertainty or multiplicity correction

four_layer_candidate_source_bindings.required_matched_comparator: common_ridge_seed_uniform_completion; each label reveal, including the common first selection, consumes budget

panels.question: Does ranking increase the chance of selecting at least one jointly qualified recorded state?
panels.marks: All three methods at every budget with pointwise paired intervals; zero reference line; no stars or winner annotation

panels.question: Does ranking reduce the distance from the best recorded strength-elongation compromise?
panels.y_label: Observed-best regret reduction over uniform (q units)
panels.marks: All three methods at every budget with pointwise paired intervals; zero reference line; same method mapping as A
panels.utility_definition: q = min(UTS/1000 MPa, reported EL/10%); regret = best q among all recorded source candidates minus best selected q; no cap at q=1
panels.gain_definition: Exact uniform expected regret minus method regret; positive values favor saved ranking
